scripts.radio:
Habari za leo, mwananchi. Welcome to this week’s edition of Kenya on Record. I'm your host, and today we are talking accountability. 

Let’s get straight to it. Former Kiambu Governor Ferdinand Waititu is facing a watershed moment in our courts. The man is staring down the barrel of 13 years behind bars, or a heavy Sh21 million fine, over a controversial Sh588.7 million irregular tender. 

Think about those numbers for a minute. Sh588 million of public funds—money meant for roads, hospitals, and mwananchi development—tied up in questionable procurement. This is the exact reason why public service must never be treated as a family business or a personal ATM. When leaders mismanage funds, it is our schools that lack books, our dispensaries that lack medicine, and our youth who stay jobless.

As taxpayers, we must ask ourselves: Is a Sh21 million fine enough for a Sh588 million loss? The wheels of justice are turning, slow as they sometimes are, but the message is clear. Accountability is catching up, whether you are in office or out of it. We must keep our eyes on the ball and demand transparency at every level of county governance.

*Na kwa ufupi kwa wale ambao wanapendelea lugha ya taifa:* Hali ni mbaya kwa aliyekuwa Gavana wa Kiambu, Ferdinand Waititu. Anatazamiwa kifungo cha miaka kumi na mitatu jela au faini ya Shilingi milioni 21 baada ya kupatikana na hatua zinazohusiana na zabuni tatanishi ya Shilingi milioni 588.7 za umma. Huu ni ukumbusho kwamba rasilimali zetu lazima zilindwe.
scripts.voice_note: Aki wakenya, nchi hii ina mambo! Former Kiambu Governor Ferdinand Waititu is really between a rock and a hard place right now. Courts are weighing a 13-year jail term or a Sh21 million fine for him over a Sh588.7 million irregular tender. Halafu bado kuna watu wanashangaa kwanini maendeleo hayafiki mashinani! Sh588 million ni pesa mob sana ambayo ingebadilisha maisha ya wananchi kule Kiambu. Hii ni funzo kubwa kwa wote wanaoshikilia nyadhifa za umma—ukila pesa za wananchi, siku moja utajibu. Share hii voice note na wenzako ili tujue Kenya tunaelekea wapi na uwajibikaji.
